onboarding.question: How do we get started with adorCV?
onboarding.answer: Onboarding takes a single day. Our team helps you import existing candidates, configure your company templates, and train the HR team. The first 30 days are completely free.

dataSafety.question: Is candidate data safe?
dataSafety.answer: Personal data never goes directly to OpenAI. A small local model detects PII, stores it locally, replaces it with placeholders, and only then sends sanitized text for extraction.

integration.question: Can adorCV integrate with our existing ATS?
integration.answer: Yes, adorCV integrates with the major ATS platforms (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters). Our RESTful API supports integration with any internal or custom system.

exportFormats.question: What export formats are available for formatted CVs?
exportFormats.answer: PDF, editable DOCX, and PPT. Templates are fully customizable with your company branding: logo, fonts, colors, and section structure.

formattingSpeed.question: How long does CV formatting take?
formattingSpeed.answer: Between 15 and 45 seconds, regardless of the original format — Word, scanned PDF, or image. The AI automatically detects key information and maps it to the chosen template.
